source_issues.finding: Trees do not consistently beat every deep-learning method on every table, nor do all neural nets overfit small tables or require hours. Full transparency and almost-no-tuning are qualitative, depth/data/implementation-dependent. No contemporary benchmark/library research performed for this translation review.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: The concrete numeric midpoint/threshold implementation cannot generally accept arbitrary string categorical values without encoding; categorical native support varies by algorithm/library. Axis-aligned rectangular regions describe numeric threshold trees, not every decision tree.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: Deep single trees are not necessarily weak learners. For identically distributed predictions, averaging can reduce variance depending on correlations; equal-bias averaging differs from changing the randomized base learner. Classification majority vote has no unconditional unchanged-bias guarantee.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: Gini is misclassification probability under an independently randomized class assignment, not necessarily the trained majority classifier error. Binary split versus balanced binary class distribution is conflated in source. Information gain conventionally often denotes entropy reduction; source explicitly extends the phrase to Gini.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: NP-hardness needs an optimality objective/constraints. A pure leaf can contain many same-label samples, conflicting duplicate features can prevent purity. Minimum leaf size constrains resulting children, not merely parent below k. Validation-error pruning description is not every post-pruning method.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: About 63% is expected unique original observations for n draws with replacement as n grows; each bootstrap fraction is random and duplicates are possible rather than logically mandatory for every draw. Out-of-bag observations differ by tree, not a single universally independent held-out set.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: sqrt(n_features) versus n_features/3 is not a universal default across software/versions or all forest variants. Feature subsampling reduces chances of the same dominant split but does not prevent shared splits; rounding and lower bound need implementation context.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: Node sample weighting is explicit in formula and code but abbreviated in prose/key terms. Normalized per-tree/forest averaging conventions matter. High-cardinality bias is a tendency; held-out permutation scores can be distorted by correlated features, weak model quality and finite noise.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: They often produce similar trees but need not rank candidate splits identically. Source request to verify agreement is not a universal mathematical identity; translation faithfully preserves the statement.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction

source_issues.finding: Doc code handles provided numeric classification fixtures; it does not validate all shapes, NaNs, criterion names, empty training data or prediction-before-fit. Zero-gain splits stop immediately, so XOR fixture remains one leaf although deeper zero-first-gain splits can solve it. Repeated RandomForest.fit appends trees: five becomes ten. No code rewritten.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; source issue not a required translation correction
